beetle.why: Plural must be of the singular lemma 'Besouro' (besouros). 'Escaravelhos' is a plural of a different synonym (escaravelho), a lemma mismatch.

bun.why: Diminutive of pão pluralizes the root: pão→pães, so pãozinho→pãezinhos.

camper.why: Loan word 'trailer' takes the English-style plural 'trailers', not a Portuguese -es plural.

cauliflower.why: Compound noun+noun; the first element must pluralize: couve→couves. Dictionary gives 'couves-flor ou couves-flores'; the current form pluralizes only the second element.
